suite: r1107 native presets disclosure source regression
method: Node VM executes the shipped disclosure controller, original r544 startup closer, preset renderer and category/filter delegates, own-set renderer wrapper and help delegate. Controlled DOM models queued/coalesced toggle delivery, storage exceptions, nesting, destructive innerHTML and zero scrollHeight below closed details.
limitations: No browser engine, computed CSS, geometry, screenshots, real native keyboard/default summary activation, pointer events, screen-reader behavior or audible output was exercised.
The fixture reproduces a zero-height hidden parent and verifies the source CSS remedy; it does not claim a rendered cascade result.
Toggle interaction is applied as DOM state changes, not a test of the browser native details implementation.
